subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class user-editable override contract for OpenClaw-owned system prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, OpenClaw Control, and Self-Update?
rationale: The request changes model-facing safety guidance, prompt precedence, and possibly workspace/config surfaces, so automation cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve scoped section overrides
options.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, cache behavior, and prompt regression tests.

options.title: Reject core section overrides
options.body: Keep OpenClaw-owned sections fixed and document before_prompt_build, provider overlays, channel prompts, and bootstrap files as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Defer to narrower prompt work
options.body: Let identity-line or append-style config-rule issues proceed independently while keeping broad Safety/template editing unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped section overrides
recommendation.body: Add a narrow named-section override model with explicit edit authority, precedence, security docs, cache behavior, and prompt regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent history on provider-owned prompt contributions and the OpenClaw-owned prompt boundary this decision would change.
